title: Design for people who cannot or will not go online
summary: Public services must work for everyone, including people without internet, skills or confidence. Design support routes alongside the digital service.

beginner: Research users who struggle with or avoid digital services.
Find out why: access, skills, confidence or trust.
Design support by phone, in person or webchat.
Measure how well the support works.
experienced: Use support data to improve the digital service.
Help people move online over time without forcing them.

toolExamples.miro: Map the journey across online and offline channels.
toolExamples.confluence: Document support routes and staff guides.

pitfalls: Paper forms as the only alternative

leaderView.good: Public services work for everyone, with support for people who can't or won't go online.
ask: How do people without internet, skills or confidence use this service?
How do we know assisted routes work?
signs: The offline route is an afterthought.
Assisted users aren't included in research.
